description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 4910016946886 LIFT,MOTOR VEHICLE: Line 0001 Qty 7 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0064 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
